kind: exploratory lever isolation on ONE search seed (42), NOT the A9 protocol (docs/ETAT.md A9 stays to be prepared by its own session)
question: Which levers of the widened profile of 2026-10-16 (Rate budget 240, six ELITE rounds, 480 joint neighbours) carry its gain over the production defaults on the 99c, at search seed 42?
witness: single witness glass for the whole 99-layer run (witness_reset_layers not set)

arms.name: C1_budget240_seul
arms.differs_from_production_defaults_by: Rate budget 240 instead of 120; rounds stay at 2, no joint neighbours, no final refinement

arms.name: C2_budget240_six_tours
arms.differs_from_C1_by: six ELITE rounds instead of 2 (the budget stays 240); still no joint neighbours, no final refinement

decomposition_read_after_the_runs: A -> C1 (+budget 240) -> C2 (+six rounds) -> B native (+480 joint neighbours: the best native plan of run B before the final refinement, read inside run B) -> B (+final refinement, -0.89 % at this seed). Each step is expressed on the consensus score and on SEEL, and as a share of the A -> B-native gap.
noise_reference: the only one available: the same arm at two search seeds (42 and 101). Best consensus score of B: 0.092536 against 0.096388 (4.2 %). Best SEEL of A: 0.7026 against 0.6559 (6.9 %); best SEEL of B: 0.6084 against 0.6067 (0.3 %). A step smaller than 4.2 % on the consensus score is not interpreted. This is a spread of two seeds, not a standard deviation.
what_is_read_in_each_arm: strategies and depositable count; best consensus score with its origin, number of blocks and Rate layers; best SEEL by the project tool (scripts/resumer_artefact_sonde.py); ELITE rounds really run (the log); duration. An arm that crashes or times out is reported as such, with no number (no valid SEEL).

sources_frozen.since_the_first_99c_runs_of_2026-10-16: HEAD was 0c7c1e2e; five commits since (868db8c9, 8c6d951b, bdcae9ed, c25937b3, 7f3edea8) touch five files: certus/ui/certus_design_ui_state.py, certus/ui/certus_measurement_excel_ui.py, certus/ui/certus_design_ui_optimization.py, certus/ui/certus_design_ui_worker.py, certus/workers/certus_strat_workers.py (injected-plan resolver; the 99c file carries no injected_strategies). None of the five mentions numba, so the Numba cache key is the one of the first runs (git show on both commits, 0 of 5).

resources.env: CERTUS_BENCH_TIMEOUT_S=36000 PYTHONUTF8=1 NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=15 OMP_NUM_THREADS=15 MKL_NUM_THREADS=15 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=15

machine_inventory_before_launch: no python process (the chain refuses to start an arm otherwise); the Codex desktop application is open but wrote nothing for about 5 hours (last writes 2026-10-16 20:57, 20:59, 21:33)
deliberately_not_in_this_run: the 480 joint neighbours alone and the final refinement alone (their own share is read inside run B, not re-measured)
any seed other than 42, any replicate of an arm, renotation on fresh groups
limits: one search seed (42), one run per arm, no confidence interval
the decomposition follows one path (A, C1, C2, B-native): levers interact (the budget is spent per round), so another order could attribute differently
the run-to-run reproducibility of the search at a fixed seed is not measured here
no scientific default is changed by this measurement; it informs the owner's decision on elite_rate_max_candidates, elite_rounds and the joint generator
rules_during_the_run: no test and no analysis Python during the measurement (the chain refuses to start the second arm if a python process runs); the logs are read with tail/grep only. Stop: TaskStop on the background task, or kill the python process tree by PID.
outputs: the probe artefacts reports/blocs_vs_plantage_99c_premium_s042_rate_budget240_seul.json and ..._rate_budget240_six_tours.json (never overwritten, by scripts/_artefact.py)
